requirements.name: Heater Initialization
requirements.reqText: The boiler shall heat water to 84°C within 90 seconds of turning on the coffee machine

requirements.name: Overheating
requirements.reqText: The thermostat shall stop all power supply if the instantaneous water heater exceeds 170°C

requirements.name: Water Tank Level
requirements.reqText: The water tank will not brew coffee if there is less than 500mL of water

requirements.name: Coffee Bean Level
requirements.reqText: The grinder will not grind coffee beans if there is less than 45g of beans within the bean container

requirements.name: Water Tank Capacity
requirements.reqText: The water tank shall be able to hold a max capacity of 2.4L

requirements.name: Coffee Bean Capacity
requirements.reqText: The coffee bean container shall be able to store a max weight of 300g of coffee beans

requirements.name: Grounds Draw Waste
requirements.reqText: The grounds draw can store a max waste capacity of 8 grounds before it is deemed full

requirements.name: Pump Pressure
requirements.reqText: The pump presser shall not be greater than 15 bar

requirements.name: System Check
requirements.reqText: The coffee machine will perform a system check to confirm coffee beans and water levels are satisfied before a coffee is made

requirements.name: System Alert
requirements.reqText: The coffee machine will alert to user of a system check to be addressed

requirements.name: Control Panel
requirements.reqText: The coffee machine shall have a digital display which the user can make selections with ease

requirements.name: Clean brewing unit
requirements.reqText: The maintenance operator shall clean the brewing unit once a week

requirements.name: Clean Machine Exterior
requirements.reqText: The maintenance operator shall clean the exterior only using water and kitchen detergent

requirements.name: Clean Water Tank
requirements.reqText: The maintenance operator shall clean the water tank 1 time per week

requirements.name: Gearmotor Overload
requirements.reqText: If the gearmotor overloads the motors electronic system shall switchoff after 8-10s and the machine is stopped

requirements.name: HWS Valve Open During Brewing
requirements.reqText: During brewing operation if the HWS valve is opened the coffee machine shall interrupt the water flow

requirements.name: Interruption By Removal Of Dregs Draw
requirements.reqText: During operation if interruption occurs by the removal of the dreg draw the machine shall continue its function unrestricted once the drawer is returned

requirements.name: Main Power Supply Disconnection During Operation
requirements.reqText: If power failure/side doors opened during operation the coffee machines gears will complete the function commenced but without brewing

requirements.name: Electrical Isolation On Dispense
requirements.reqText: During water dispensing the coffee machine shall electrically isolate the water path and incorporate a residual current device (RCD) so that a short circuit cannot energise the chassis or expose the operator to electric shock.

requirements.name: Regulatory Compliance Mark
requirements.reqText: The coffee machine unit shall not be sold unless it has a RCM with the Australian standards of the AS/NZS 4417.1 and AS/NZS 4417.2
